prerequisites: Knowledge of Fundamentals of Thermal Engineering
Knowledge of Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics Engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Know, master, and apply all necessary concepts to design basic installations, mainly in building.
Know, master, and apply everything related to the RITE (Regulations for Thermal Installations in Buildings) and its applications in building and industry.

Know, master, and apply everything related to the Technical Building Code (CTE) and its applications in building, especially thermal installations, solar thermal installations, ventilation installations, fire protection, cold and hot water networks, and rainwater and wastewater evacuation (CTE-DB-HE, CTE-DB-HS, in the corresponding sections).
Have a solid foundation to adapt knowledge and its applications to subsequent more complex installation designs and their optimization.

Acquire the foundations to be able to apply knowledge to practice, using basic computer tools, information search and management, expressing oneself adequately in one's own language and working autonomously, on the one hand; on the other hand, acquire the foundations to be able to apply knowledge to practice, planning and managing time, making decisions and orienting these to results, as well as leading groups using interpersonal skills.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1: Introduction - Generalities - Basic Energy Saving Document of the Technical Building Code (CTE-DB-HE) - Basic Health Document of the Technical Building Code (CTE-DB-HS) - Regulation of Thermal Installations in Buildings (RITE)
Topic 2: Cold Water Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 3: Domestic Hot Water Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 4: Solar Thermal and Photovoltaic Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 5: Heating Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 6: Sanitation Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 7: Ventilation Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 8: Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Installations - Applicable regulations - Installation elements - Calculation and design of the installation
Topic 9: Other Installations - Fire Fighting Installations - Elevator and Hoist Installations - Lighting Installations - Waste Collection and Evacuation Installations

Topic 10: Design of Basic Mechanical Installations in Industry and/or Building - Practical case of CTE-DB-HE application - Practical case of CTE-DB-HS application - Practical case of installation design
assessment_rules: A minimum of 35% of the total score from written tests is required to pass. If this critical evaluation criterion is not met, the final grade for the course will be a FAIL, with the resulting score from the sum of all evaluation systems, truncated to a maximum of 4.5 points.
